records.title: TransHands: Repurposing Human Pose Encoders as Hand Pose Encoders
records.reason: The paper concerns hand-pose estimation encoders and contains no LLM inference contribution.

records.title: Kernel Token Contradiction: a Fast and Principled Approach for LLM Claim Uncertainty Quantification
records.reason: The efficiency target is post-generation uncertainty monitoring, not reducing LLM generation/serving cost itself. Its fit to this LLM inference-efficiency survey is adjacent and weak.

records.title: CausalCache: Conditional High-Fidelity Restoration for Long-Horizon GUI Agents
records.reason: The intervention reallocates a fixed visual budget for task quality rather than reducing LLM inference resources; added selection overhead is material. Scope fit is weak.

records.title: Enabling Agentic AI across the Cloud-Edge Computing Continuum: A Research Roadmap
records.reason: The paper is a broad cloud-edge agentic-AI research roadmap rather than a concrete LLM inference/serving efficiency result.

records.title: The Entropy of Artificial Cognition: Deciphering the Anthropogenic Footprint and Multilingual Energetic Tax of Large Language Models
records.reason: The abstract synthesizes existing environmental-impact studies and recommends Green-AI practices; it does not present a primary LLM inference optimization or measured serving system.
